name: Semtech Corporation
moat_justification: Real IP in LoRa (owns the core patents, anchors the LoRaWAN standard) and a leading early position in active copper cables / linear pluggable optics for AI data centers, but the economics do not yet prove a moat: ROIC proxy was 20.5% in FY2022 then 3.9% / -79.8% (Sierra impairment) / 4.2% / 3.0% across FY2023-26, and gross margin at 51.6% in FY2026 is still ~11pp below the pre-Sierra 62-63%. Signal-integrity rivals (Broadcom, Marvell, MACOM) outspend it and each speed generation re-opens the contest; the Sierra acquisition destroyed capital. CAP = 7.2 years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 11.4%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025, 2026 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

IRR_AT_FLOOR: implied IRR sits within 0.5pp of terminal growth 2.5% (super_bear) — a perpetuity growing at g has an IRR above g at any price, so the model cannot express a return below ~2.5%; this price is beyond the model's range and the expected return is 'at most ~3.0%', not the recorded figure
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 0.7% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 8.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 3.4x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Real LoRa and AI-interconnect franchise (moat 4/10) but owner's earnings are $0.98/share TTM against a $141.16 price — 3.96% weighted IRR, IV@15% $14.32; it clears 15% only below ~$14.
moat_for: LoRa core IP ownership and LoRaWAN standard/ecosystem control in low-power wide-area IoT
Leading early position in active copper cables (CopperEdge) and linear pluggable optics for AI data-center interconnect
PerSe sensing IP designed into consumer devices
moat_against: ROIC proxy 3-4% in FY2025-26 and gross margin ~11pp below pre-Sierra levels — position not converting to returns
Broadcom, Marvell and MACOM competition; interconnect lead must be re-earned at each speed generation (800G to 1.6T)
Sierra Wireless acquisition destroyed capital (FY2024 net loss -$1,092M, negative equity) — poor capital allocation record
Semiconductor cyclicality and hyperscaler capex concentration in the growth segment
